transcript: This public message contains a rule and a reason. A student group at the train station tested three ways to protect young plants. Covers blocked wind but also reduced light. A low wall stopped some wind without shading the leaves. Moving the plants indoors kept them warm but required more space. The group chose the low wall for the next two weeks.
